name: 16d dynamic loss scaling
title: Dynamic loss scaling for fp16 gradients
subtitle: fp16 holds magnitudes from 5.96e-8 to 65,504; scale starts at 65,536, halves on overflow, doubles after 2 clean steps (toy interval)

steps.caption: Unscaled, the smallest gradient of 2e-8 is below half the smallest fp16 number and would round to 0. Times 65,536 it becomes 1.31e-3, and the largest, 0.5, becomes 32,768, below 65,504.
This batch has a gradient of 1.2. Times 65,536 that is 78,643, past 65,504, so it becomes infinity. The update is skipped and the scale is halved.
The next batch has the same spread. At 32,768 the gradient of 1.2 becomes 39,322 and 2e-8 becomes 6.55e-4, so everything fits and the step goes ahead.
A second clean step, largest gradient 0.8 becoming 26,214, completes the toy growth interval of 2, so the scale doubles back to 65,536 to probe for more headroom.
Before the update every gradient is divided by the scale in fp32, and only then clipped. With the real growth interval of 2,000, about one step in 2,000 is skipped.
